subject: PO specs, timeline & onboarding checklist — kickoff
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Gibbs <laura.gibbs@acmecorp.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: PO specs, timeline & onboarding checklist — kickoff

Hi Laura / Acme procurement team,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood — excited to get the procurement steps in motion so we can target the May 10 go-live for the initial dedicated capacity pool. To keep things tight I wanted to outline the items we need to confirm and propose a short timeline. Please see the checklist below and flag anything that won’t work from your side.

Must-have items for PO issuance and vendor setup:
- PO requirement confirmation: does Acme require a separate Redwood vendor entity on your PO (Redwood Inference, Inc.) or will parent-level invoicing be used?
- PO line-item structure: do you prefer a single-line PO with an order-of-magnitude total and a reference to our SOW, or a per-sku breakdown (Reserved GPUs, burst credits, support add-on)?
- Billing terms & remit: net-30 by default unless your AP team requires net-45/60 or ACH details.
- Insurance & tax info: current COI and Redwood tax ID required for vendor record.
- Procurement contacts for W-9/contract countersign and vendor setup.

Proposed short timeline (we can adjust):
- Today (Apr 22): confirm PO structure preference + billing terms + vendor legal name
- Apr 23–27: Redwood sends PO template and onboarding checklist; Acme raises PO and sends signed PO back to procurement@redwoodinference.com
- Apr 28–May 4: Vendor setup in Acme ERP; Redwood provisions reserved capacity (scheduling window)
- May 10: Target start for initial pool (kickoff and validation)

If helpful, I’ve attached a brief onboarding checklist and a PO template that Acme can drop into your ERP. Dev (cc’d) can provide line-item examples if you want a per-sku breakdown.

Next step: Laura — can you confirm your PO line-item preference and the correct legal name for invoicing?

Thanks,
Neha
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0178

Attachments: Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist_v1.pdf (8 KB stub), PO_Template_ACME.xlsx (12 KB stub)
From: Laura Gibbs <laura.gibbs@acmecorp.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmecorp.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmecorp.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO specs, timeline & onboarding checklist — kickoff

Hi Neha — thanks for the clear list. A few quick answers from our side: 

- Legal name: Acme Enterprises, Inc. (we’ll need Redwood Inference, Inc. as the vendor on the PO).
- Line-item preference: Our ERP (Coupa) prefers discrete line items for clarity — please provide the suggested SKU breakdown and unit prices. We can also accept a single-line if you flag each cost in an attached SOW, but discrete lines speed approvals.
- Billing terms: Net-30 is standard for us.
- Insurance: Please send COI and liability limits; we’ll confirm if they meet Acme minimums.

We’ll aim to have a PO drafted by Apr 27 if Dev’s line items are available today. Tom from procurement is helping own the vendor setup — looping him to coordinate ERP entry and any mandatory vendor forms.

Laura
Laura Gibbs
Head of Vendor Ops, AcmeCorp
laura.gibbs@acmecorp.com
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: PO specs, timeline & onboarding checklist — internal follow-up

Neha / Priyom — forwarding Laura’s reply. Two quick clarifications from engineering/ops for the line-item breakdown: 

Proposed per-sku items (example):
1) Reserved capacity (monthly) — N x GPU-H100-80GB reserved hours (unit = month)
2) Burst credits (optional) — pay-as-you-go token pooling (unit = token-block)
3) Premium support (24/7) — flat monthly fee
4) Data processing add-on (if private deployment) — flat setup + monthly fee

We should include unit price, quantity, and a short description per line so Acme’s Coupa mapping is straightforward. I’ll prepare a sample spreadsheet that maps to the PO_Template_ACME.xlsx and include the internal SKU ids we recommend.

Also: confirm whether Acme requires separate tax-exempt or state-specific billing addresses — I recall some of their subsidiaries use multiple remit addresses.

— Dev
Dev Patel
VP, Cloud Operations (Redwood)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Gibbs <laura.gibbs@acmecorp.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO specs, timeline & onboarding checklist — kickoff

Thanks Laura — perfect, that helps a lot. 

Dev — attaching the filled sample line-item worksheet (see PO_Template_ACME.xlsx) with the mapping to Coupa-friendly fields: ItemCode, Description, Unit, UnitPrice, Quantity, Total, CostCenter. I’ve also called out the recommended single-line fallback in the bottom note in case approvals prefer that route.

Acme procurement team — next logistical asks from our side:
- Please confirm AP remit address and any subsidiary-specific tax IDs we should put on the invoice.
- If you require a formal vendor questionnaire (PDF) returned, let us know and we’ll have that completed by Apr 24.

If everything looks good, we’ll expect the signed PO back (scanned PDF) to procurement@redwoodinference.com by Apr 27 so we can meet the provisioning window.

Best,
Neha
From: Laura Gibbs <laura.gibbs@acmecorp.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmecorp.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Apr 2026 11:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO specs, timeline & onboarding checklist — kickoff

Neha / Dev — thanks for the worksheet — that layout will work for Coupa. We have two small items before we push the PO into the system: 

1) Please send a Certificate of Insurance (COI) showing commercial general liability at $1M and cyber liability at $2M.
2) Provide Redwood’s W-9 or equivalent tax form for vendor setup.

Once we have those two attachments we’ll draft the PO and aim to submit the signed PO back to you by Apr 27. If anything slips, we’ll notify you immediately.

Tom will follow up with the vendor setup link (his note coming separately).

Regards,
Laura
